text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Craft-san. Recite the 
periodic table starting from element 1!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: H, He, Li, Be, B, C, N, O, F, Ne!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, Hydrogen, Helium, Lithium, Beryllium, 
Bo... o? —...Borium!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
'Boron', not 'borium'. And the 'berium' 
you mentioned before is correctly called 
'beryllium', you know.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Aww, that was a trick question...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Where's the trick question in the periodic 
table...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, you got three right, so time for a 
break! I've prepared those cocoa cookies 
you love so much, Craft.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Hold on, Cesario-san. This is test 
prep for Craft-san, you know. Isn't that 
being a bit too soft on her?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry♪ I made tons of snacks so that 
it won't matter if it takes hours until 
you've got it down perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Then on the flip side, if you can't 
memorize it all, Craft-san will be—all 
day?
